ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity (white/off-white) area relative to 25% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) area across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) border along the trailing edge. A significant, jagged dark-intensity patch originates at the median notch vertex. Stochastic low-intensity mottling and speckling are distributed across the interior high-intensity regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree angle at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern featuring irregular peaks and valleys (amplitude variance of 3-8 pixels) across the longitudinal span of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature characterized by a steep gradient from the distal tips descending toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-intensity, near-parallel linear disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the right lobe (viewer perspective) and horizontal-trending marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brownish-yellow textured clusters indicative of biofouling or calcified accumulation are visible on the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, irregular dark pigment patch is localized at the interior junction where the two lobes meet the peduncle.
